title: Tu Badi Dukhi Hai
body:
tu badi dukhi hai fatema
ab bhi ro rahi hai fatema
<<DIVIDER>>
jo rida teri hai fatema
khoon se bhari hai fatema
tu badi dukhi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
phasliyon se ris raha hai khoon
saans le rahi hai fatema
tu badi dukhi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
chup ke dekhte hai murtaza
chup ke ro rahi hai fatema
tu badi dukhi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema ko kha gayi ye baat
jhoot keh rahi hai fatema
tu badi dukhi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
thokaro se maarte ho kyun
dukhtar e nabi hai fatema
tu badi dukhi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
gir gaye hai moo ke bal ali
aaj chal basi hai fatema
tu badi dukhi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
neend se hussain uth gaye
yaad aa rahi hai fatema
tu badi dukhi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaatilon ke naam bhi na loo
kaise bebasi hai fatema
tu badi dukhi hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mir bas ghadeer ke liye
aag par chali hai fatema
tu badi dukhi hai...
author: Mir Sajjad Mir
